messages:
cj_finance: Heads-up — partner reported overcharge on INV-2026-1201 for Dec partial-month seat change. Appears proration not applied on marketplace invoice. :confused:

leah_billing: Which partner? drop the invoice snippet pls.

cj_finance: Partner: CloudHarbor Channel (CH-3170). Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-1201 | SKU: CH-RES-SEAT | Period: 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31 | Seats billed: 30 | Seat change: 20->10 on 2026-12-10 | Rate: $15/seat | Amount billed: $450.00
Expected proration -> 9 days @20 seats + 21 days @10 seats -> expected amount = $ (20*9/31*15) + (10*22/31*15) ≈ $ (87.10) + (106.45) ≈ $193.55 -> diff ~$256.45 credit
```

omar_recon: Running mediation audit now. billing_ledger shows invoice_line.quantity=30 and proration_factor=null for that line. Looks like marketplace-mediator didn't pick up mid-period seat update.

invoicebot: Invoice INV-2026-1201 generated by marketplace-mediator v1.10.2 at 2026-12-31T02:10:05Z. No proration token attached to line item.

nina_partnerops: Partner ops had seat-reduction event `PARTNER_UPDATE_SEATS CH-3170 seats=10` on 2026-12-10T11:05:12Z. Webhook delivery to mediator shows 200 OK, but payload version v2 vs mediator expected v3 after recent deploy. Possible schema mismatch.

leah_billing: If mediator ignored the event due to schema, that's a functional bug. For fix: we need to 1) calculate corrective credit, 2) open ENG ticket to accept v2/v3 aliases, 3) consider re-issuing corrected invoice or issue credit memo.

cj_finance: Proposed credit = $450.00 - $193.55 = $256.45. GL: 4330 (Customer Credits - Marketplace). Confirm?

omar_recon: I agree with calculation. I'll add detailed ledger query + webhook delivery logs to the billing-reconcile sheet.

invoicebot: Support case AWS-231004 opened referencing invoice INV-2026-1201 and partner CH-3170.

nina_partnerops: I'll coordinate with CloudHarbor AE to request partner consent for a retro credit. They prefer a corrected invoice if possible.

leah_billing: Finance rule: prefer credit memo for marketplace corrections under $1k unless partner explicitly requests reissue. CJ please confirm partner preference.

cj_finance: I've messaged AE — partner prefers corrected invoice. Leah: can finance accommodate invoice reissue workflow?

leah_billing: We can reissue but it requires mediator re-run and accounting approval. Might delay revenue recognition. For speed, we should offer credit now and reissue only if partner insists. Hold until AE responds.

omar_recon: I'll file INF-7210 to add backward-compatible payload parsing and a unit test for proration_token mapping. Also adding replay hook to safely reprocess partner events for the month window.

invoicebot: Billing-reconcile row added: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED. Ledger query attached.

nina_partnerops: AE replied — CloudHarbor prefers corrected invoice. They've agreed to waive timing concerns if we reissue. I'll escalate for priority.

leah_billing: Ok finance sign-off conditional: reissue is ok if engineering can re-run mediation for Dec safely and we attach an explanatory credit note. Please confirm INF-7210 ETA.

omar_recon: INF-7210 assigned to eng-mediator; ETA 3 business days for patch + safe replay checklist. If we get that, proceed with reissue.

cj_finance: Thanks team. Please keep this thread updated. I'll hold the GL entry until reissue completes. :white_check_mark:
